name: Damian Fadel
home: the western blocks near Ferry Street Rooms
life: “I still remember handing over a key after being left off the staff list.” Friday often includes a stop at the downtown fountain, where Damian keeps a little time free to hear who is playing at the far end of the park.
voice: I have the keys and no vote. I have offered every voter an hour inside on a working day.
appearance: On an ordinary day, look for a charcoal zip cardigan and a printed handkerchief folded into the pocket. Damian has a scattering of freckles across the bridge of the nose, with a center part and straight chestnut hair. Damian presses the lips together to keep a smile in during a conversation.
personality: Damian treats a small promise with the gravity others reserve for a contract. This makes Damian lovely to rely on and surprisingly difficult to invite on a whim.
agenda: To get decision-makers inside during a working shift.
family: Jaime Holt is Damian’s cousin. Damian can stop the walk at any corner. Jaime chooses the familiar route. Walking side by side makes it easier to disagree without turning each disagreement into a contest. Asked about *A wall of birthdays*, Jaime says, “My kids have moved five times. We're starting their marks on a board we can carry through any door.”
connections: Roman Wade. The worker hired after prison shows the keyholder which overlooked jobs should be visible on the tour.

reactions.situation: A worker says their job was left out of the consultation
reactions.response: Damian records the missing job in the worker's own words for the consultation.
reactions.asWritten: A worker says their job was left out of the consultation. Damian records the missing job in the worker's own words for the consultation.

reactions.situation: The last bus leaves while an elderly stranger is still crossing toward it
reactions.response: Damian offers to walk to the next staffed place together, at the stranger's pace, to ask about another ride.

reactions.situation: When offered a favor with ambiguous terms
reactions.response: Damian says what can be returned and asks whether that will do.
